7d2efa7c90e073a6.description: About Jacobs Engineering Group Inc. Jacobs Engineering Group Inc. is dedicated to addressing critical global challenges across various sectors, including urban development, environmental resilience, and scientific discovery. The company focuses on transforming conceptual ideas into tangible solutions that contribute positively to the world. Role Overview: Lead Cost Engineer Jacobs is seeking a Lead Cost Engineer for a full-time position in Saudi Arabia, with locations in Neom and Riyadh. This role is central to managing cost reporting and control for the closeout portfolio. The Lead Cost Engineer will oversee budgets, accruals, commitments, cash flow, funding, and forecasts, providing clear financial insights to the Project Controls Manager and senior stakeholders regarding current cost positions, forecast final costs, and closeout funding requirements. A minimum of 10 years of experience is required for this position. Key Responsibilities Manage cost reporting across the portfolio, defining the monthly cost control cycle, data requirements, and review timetable. Administer approved budgets, allocations, transfers, and cost coding across multiple contracts and workstreams. Develop and maintain detailed forecasts, forecast-at-completion positions, and closeout cost projections. Oversee the monthly accrual process, including validation, reconciliation, aging review, and clearing of unsupported or duplicate accruals. Track commitments, actual costs, pending liabilities, settlements, and remaining exposure through contract closure. Prepare cash flow forecasts and funding requirements for termination, demobilization, preservation, settlement, and closeout. Reconcile data from SAP, Oracle Unifier, commercial records, and project reporting, resolving material differences. Lead cost inputs for weekly reports, monthly portfolio reports, closeout reports, preservation cost reports, dashboards, and presentations. Provide cost substantiation and supporting records for claims, disputes, settlement discussions, and final account reviews. Establish cost reporting templates, controls, and data checks, ensuring a clear audit trail for assumptions and forecast changes. Explain movements in budgets, commitments, accruals, actuals, cash flow, and forecasts. Support the Project Controls Manager in portfolio reviews and senior stakeholder discussions. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 20 years of experience in cost engineering or a related field. Demonstrated ability to manage complex cost reporting and control processes. Proficiency in financial systems such as SAP and Oracle Unifier. Strong analytical skills for forecasting, reconciliation, and financial substantiation. Work Environment at Jacobs Jacobs fosters a culture of care, promoting diversity and inclusion. Employees benefit from global and local connections, leveraging diverse perspectives for collective strength. The company emphasizes collaboration, mutual support, and flexibility, offering arrangements that maximize individual potential. Jacobs operates with a hybrid working policy, allowing employees to divide their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations. Onsite employees are expected to attend a Jacobs Workplace on a full-time basis as required by their role.

7d0e5d3f0075df84.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة منهل المعرفة الأهلية عن معلم ابتدائي لغة أجنبية للانضمام إلى فريقها في ينبع، المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تدريس طلاب المرحلة الابتدائية مواد متنوعة باللغة الأجنبية، بما في ذلك القراءة والكتابة والرياضيات، مع التركيز على تطوير خطط الدروس وتقديم التعليمات الفردية والجماعية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تطوير خطط الدروس بما يتماشى مع المنهج الدراسي والرؤية الأكاديمية للمدرسة، واختيار المصادر، وتصميم المواد التعليمية والدروس وطرق التدريس الأخرى. تدريس الطلاب باللغة الأجنبية في مجالات القراءة والكتابة والرياضيات والعلوم والفنون والتربية البدنية والموسيقى وغيرها من المواد الابتدائية. تقديم الدروس الفردية والجماعية، وتيسير المناقشات، وتحديد الواجبات، وتنظيم الرحلات والأنشطة العملية. إدارة سلوك الطلاب وتفاعلاتهم داخل البيئة التعليمية. تقييم تقدم الطلاب ونموهم الأكاديمي والاجتماعي بشكل مستمر. تقديم المشورة للطلاب وأولياء أمورهم لتحسين الأداء والسلوك، وتحديد الطلاب الذين يحتاجون إلى اهتمام إضافي وتحديد الطرق المناسبة لتلبية احتياجاتهم. تسجيل الحضور والدرجات وأداء الطلاب بشكل فردي وإعداد التقارير اللازمة. حضور اجتماعات الموظفين والتنسيق مع الزملاء المدرسين والمسؤولين ومساعدي المدرسين. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في تدريس المرحلة الابتدائية. القدرة على تدريس مواد متنوعة باللغة الأجنبية. مهارات ممتازة في التخطيط والتنظيم وتصميم المحتوى التعليمي. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل قوية وفعالة مع الطلاب وأولياء الأمور والزملاء. القدرة على إدارة الفصول الدراسية بفعالية. المرونة والتكيف مع الاحتياجات التعليمية المختلفة للطلاب. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق تعليمي متكامل. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في ينبع، المدينة المنورة، ضمن بيئة تعليمية داعمة ومحفزة في شركة منهل المعرفة الأهلية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، ولن يتم الكشف عنه في هذه المرحلة.

7da40b78b6f51905.job_title: Chief Specialist Accelerating Discovery to Development (E&RD Business Partner)
7da40b78b6f51905.company_name: Ma'aden - Saudi Arabian Mining Company | معادن
7da40b78b6f51905.description: About Ma'aden and the Role Ma'aden, established in 1997, is a multi-commodity mining and metals company in the Middle East, contributing to the development of Saudi Arabia's economy. This full-time role for a Chief Specialist, Accelerating Discovery to Development (E&RD Business Partner), is based in Riyadh and requires over 10 years of experience. Role Purpose The Chief Specialist, Accelerating Discovery to Development, focuses on transforming the application of technology in mineral exploration at Ma’aden. This involves accelerating the process from initial exploration insights to scientifically validated, decision-ready evidence. The role connects advanced technologies such as automation, sensing, Data & AI, subsurface analytics, and laboratory science to enhance exploration capabilities. As an enterprise technical authority, this position guides the selection, validation, and application of emerging technologies across the exploration lifecycle, aiming to shorten learning cycles, improve confidence in findings, and strengthen the technical basis for investment decisions. Key Responsibilities Shape the enterprise exploration technology roadmap to accelerate discovery and validation through automation, advanced sensing, AI-enabled targeting, and intelligent drilling. Translate emerging technologies into deployable exploration capabilities, selecting solutions based on scientific validity, technology readiness, field applicability, and potential business value. Build Ma’aden’s technical advantage by identifying and adapting relevant technologies and practices from Oil & Gas subsurface science, space exploration, OEMs, academia, and research institutions. Advance AI-enabled exploration by integrating geological, geophysical, geochemical, and remote-sensing information to strengthen subsurface interpretation, target ranking, and uncertainty management. Apply advanced analytics, including predictive modelling, deep learning, physics-informed AI, and probabilistic approaches, to increase the speed and confidence of exploration insights. Establish confidence-based decision metrics that make uncertainty, reproducibility, and learning rate visible alongside conventional exploration measures. Transform the field-to-lab validation cycle by connecting sensing, drilling, and sampling with high-throughput analytical methods, automated core analysis, and digital sample traceability. Accelerate independent and reproducible validation of exploration findings, reducing analytical turnaround, rework, and delays between initial observation and decision-ready evidence. Strengthen approval readiness by establishing fit-for-purpose certified analytical technologies, traceable data, and scientifically defensible methods. Design scalable field-lab-digital workflows that connect field acquisition, laboratory analysis, and AI-enabled interpretation into a coherent exploration technology model. Enable greater exploration productivity through automation, digital twins, sensor fusion, autonomous or remote technologies, and AI-assisted decision workflows. Align laboratory capacity, automation, and digital capability with exploration ambition. Evaluate frontier technologies for practical exploration value, balancing scientific robustness, technology readiness, deployment constraints, cost, risk, and scalability. Accelerate transfer of proven cross-industry innovation into mineral exploration, particularly in autonomous systems, subsurface analytics, remote sensing, and extreme-environment instrumentation. Demonstrate measurable technology value through shorter learning and validation cycles, lower re-testing and re-sampling, improved target confidence, and more efficient exploration workflows. Success Metrics Achieve shorter field-to-validated-result cycle times, enabling faster technical and portfolio decisions. Reduce laboratory turnaround time and avoidable re-analysis, with improved first-time quality, traceability, and reproducibility of critical results. Attain higher confidence in drill-ready targets, supported by integrated data, explicit uncertainty measures, and scientifically defensible validation. Ensure faster progression from exploration concept to drill-ready target through effective application of automation, AI, and advanced sensing technologies. Improve exploration efficiency, demonstrated through reduced cost, re-sampling, re-testing, and decision latency attributable to technology-enabled workflows. Achieve successful adoption and scaling of high-value technologies, including AI-enabled exploration and relevant cross-industry innovations. Experience Required Candidates should possess more than 10 years of relevant experience in a related field.

7df67622f00c172c.description: About the Role King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST) is seeking a Staff Scientist for its Viral Vector Facility (VVF). This full-time role is central to supporting the strategic goals of KAUST's Bio-Medical platform. The Staff Scientist will be responsible for designing, producing, and delivering high-quality viral vectors, such as AAVs and Lentivirus, to support advanced research within KAUST and the broader region. The position requires 5-10 years of experience. Role Context and Objectives The Staff Scientist will optimize and scale production workflows, enhance vector performance, and improve cost-efficiency while ensuring strict quality and biosafety standards. This role involves translating complex experimental needs into tailored genetic tools and driving innovation in vector design and delivery. The scientist will collaborate with researchers, supervise technical staff, and provide advanced training in molecular genetics and viral vector technologies, contributing to KAUST's position as a regional hub for state-of-the-art viral vector solutions. Key Responsibilities Collaborate with researchers to identify and implement appropriate viral vector systems for scientific questions, supporting high-impact research. Produce high-quality, safe, and effective viral vectors tailored for experimental needs and cell-based research applications. Supervise and mentor a laboratory technician, managing daily tasks to ensure timely and high-quality deliverables. Coordinate multiple research projects and timelines to ensure milestones and deliverables are met on schedule. Develop, implement, and enforce Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for efficiency, reproducibility, and compliance in viral vector production. Ensure Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) and maintain a safe working environment in accordance with biosafety regulations and Institutional Biosafety and Ethics Committee (IBEC) guidelines. Integrate laboratory data into the Bio-Medical Platform and collaborate with IT and bioinformatics teams for effective data management, analysis, and reporting. Design and implement new or improved techniques and workflows to address scientific challenges, enhance viral vector performance and throughput, and reduce production costs. Provide advanced training in viral vector production and contribute to building technical expertise among staff. Conduct routine laboratory responsibilities, including procurement, documentation, equipment maintenance, and participation in task forces and institutional committees. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess a strong background in molecular biology with expertise in viral vector engineering and production. The role requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Required Skills Expertise in viral vector engineering and production (*, AAVs and Lentivirus). Proficiency in optimizing and scaling production workflows. Ability to ensure strict quality and biosafety standards. Strong molecular biology skills. Experience in translating experimental needs into genetic tools. Capability to supervise technical staff and provide advanced training. Knowledge of Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) and biosafety regulations. Work Environment This full-time position is based at King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST), working within the Viral Vector Facility as part of the Bio-Medical platform. The role involves close collaboration with researchers and managing a laboratory technician.

The team's customer-first approach has contributed to AWS becoming a widely adopted cloud platform.

Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within a team of dedicated experts focused on driving the company's path and supporting critical operations. About CAE CAE's mission is to contribute to a safer world by innovating in simulation, training, and mission readiness. The company leverages advanced technologies to enable customers to operate smarter, faster, and more sustainably. CAE encourages bold ideas and collaboration to achieve shared success.

The role establishes the standards, ownership, controls, and master data foundations required for reliable reporting, analytics, artificial intelligence, automation, and business decision-making. The role creates value by improving the accuracy, consistency, traceability, and usability of critical data across business functions and technology platforms. Strong governance and master data practices reduce operational inefficiency, limit data-related risk, improve regulatory and audit readiness, and enable teams to make decisions with greater confidence. As a specialist authority, the role turns enterprise governance requirements into practical controls, clear accountabilities, and sustainable ways of working. The role also builds a culture in which data owners, stewards, and users understand their responsibilities and actively improve the quality and value of Ma’aden’s information assets. 2. What You Will Deliver Enterprise Data Governance Establish governance frameworks, policies, standards, and decision rights that strengthen ownership and accountability for critical data. Data Quality, Metadata & Traceability Define measurable quality rules and controls for completeness, accuracy, consistency, validity, and timeliness. Drive root-cause resolution of recurring data issues and track improvements through agreed quality indicators. Strengthen data discoverability and trust through effective metadata, lineage, cataloguing, and traceability practices. Governed Platforms & Digital Enablement Integrate data quality, ownership, security, metadata, and lineage controls into data pipelines, cloud environments, and analytics platforms. Enable scalable and governed data foundations for reporting, advanced analytics, AI, and digital initiatives. Apply automation and analytics to improve control effectiveness, issue detection, and governance efficiency. Risk, Compliance & Assurance Identify and mitigate governance, privacy, security, and master data risks before they affect business performance. Maintain evidence-based controls that strengthen regulatory compliance, audit readiness, and accountability. Monitor adherence to governance standards and drive corrective action where control gaps are identified. Adoption & Capability Building Equip data owners, stewards, analysts, and technology teams with practical playbooks, procedures, and governance guidance. Influence business and technology stakeholders to adopt master data standards and accountable data practices. Build sustainable governance capability through mentoring, knowledge transfer, and continuous improvement. 3. What Success Looks Like Critical data domains achieve agreed improvements in completeness, accuracy, consistency, validity, and timeliness. Master data standards and hierarchies are consistently adopted across priority systems and business processes. Recurring data issues, duplicate records, reconciliation effort, and control exceptions reduce over time. Critical data assets have clearly assigned owners and stewards, supported by documented accountability. Metadata, lineage, and catalogue coverage improve for priority data assets, increasing traceability and user confidence. Analytics, AI, reporting, and automation initiatives use governed data that meets defined quality and compliance requirements. 4. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Management, Information Systems, or a related discipline. 5. Experience 8–10 years of relevant experience in data governance, master data management, or enterprise data management. 7d27018129c67d64.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة بواني العمران للمقاولات عن اخصائي ذكاء اصطناعي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على تحديد مصادر البيانات، وإجراء التحليلات العلمية، وتطوير الحلول القائمة على الذكاء الاصطناعي لدعم عمليات الشركة. سيعمل شاغل الوظيفة على إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة، والمساهمة في تحسين الأداء العام من خلال استخدام أحدث المنهجيات والتقنيات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل الخطط وتفصيلها إلى عمليات منظمة، وتنظيم الأنشطة ومسار سير المعلومات لضمان تحقيق الأهداف المرجوة. تحليل النظريات والمنهجيات والتقنيات المعلوماتية التي تحول البيانات الأولية إلى معلومات مفيدة للأعمال، وتقديم التوصيات بتبني أفضل الأساليب الحديثة. جمع وتحليل المعلومات والبيانات المتعلقة بالجهة المعنية بشكل مستمر، وإعداد التوصيات لمناقشتها مع إدارات تقنية المعلومات لدعم اتخاذ القرار وتحسين الأداء. تحليل الأعمال لتحديد استراتيجيات العمل المناسبة ووضع حلول للمشاكل التخطيطية، مع ضمان توفر التحليلات والمبررات المنطقية للنتائج. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة في مجال الذكاء الاصطناعي، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الذكاء الاصطناعي أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تحديد مصادر المعلومات والبيانات اللازمة لإعداد التحليلات والاختبارات العلمية. معرفة بأفضل الطرق والأدوات والأساليب لجمع البيانات وتنظيمها وتحليلها. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض. سيعمل اخصائي الذكاء الاصطناعي ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تطبيق أحدث التقنيات لتحسين كفاءة العمليات واتخاذ القرارات. ملخص الدور يتولى اخصائي الذكاء الاصطناعي مسؤولية تحليل البيانات وتطوير الحلول الذكية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. يساهم هذا الدور بشكل مباشر في دعم عمليات الشركة وتحسين أدائها من خلال تطبيق مبادئ الذكاء الاصطناعي. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة.

7d2745ca8960ce7c.description: About the Role Nestlé KSA is seeking a Field Sales Representative to manage and deliver sales within a designated area. Key activities include managing Nestlé items, addressing systemic out-of-stock issues, ensuring rapid distribution of new products, optimizing shelf share, maintaining price compliance, and executing promotional sales strategies. Key Responsibilities Collaborate with customers to ensure product knowledge through in-person and phone communication. Sell incremental volume for displays and secure maximum support for promoted products. Identify and sell additional products based on observed market opportunities. Work with targeted customers to create and execute business reviews aimed at driving volume. Manage financial resources responsibly. Ensure timely payment collection from customers. Verify compliance with pricing guidelines at the retail level. Report competitive price changes and promotional support, and resolve related pricing issues. Identify and correct product voids, ensuring the availability of new items. Merchandise products to achieve schematic compliance, rotate stock, manage unsellable products, and resolve systemic out-of-stock and void problems. Required Qualifications and Skills Excellent customer service, organizational skills, and attention to detail. Strong communication (oral and written), selling, and analytical skills. Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) and other POS systems. Ability to analyze financial, inventory, retail conditions, and other data to apply appropriate selling techniques. 7d32881f744c1a18.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مجموعة المجال العربي عن مراقب خدمات عامة للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى مراجعة وتنسيق أعمال موظفي الخدمات العامة، وتطوير إجراءات العمل، ومعالجة المشكلات التشغيلية، بالإضافة إلى تقييم الأداء وتنمية المهارات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراجعة وتنسيق أعمال ونشاطات موظفي الخدمات العامة، وتحديد مهامهم وواجباتهم بناءً على حجم العمل والأولويات وقدرات الموظفين. إعداد وتطوير برامج وإجراءات العمل، وتنسيق الأنشطة مع الوحدات التنظيمية الأخرى ذات الصلة. دراسة مشكلات العمل، وتحديد أسبابها، واقتراح بدائل الحلول الممكنة، واختيار الحل الأنسب، ثم متابعة التنفيذ والتقييم. تقييم أداء موظفي الخدمات العامة ومدى التزامهم باللوائح التنظيمية المتعلقة بمجال العمل. تحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية الفردية للموظفين وتنمية مهاراتهم، أو التوصية بإلحاقهم ببرامج تدريبية متخصصة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل دوري ومنظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على مراجعة وتنسيق الأعمال بفعالية. مهارات في إعداد وتطوير برامج وإجراءات العمل. القدرة على تحليل المشكلات واقتراح الحلول. مهارات تقييم الأداء وتحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة مكة المكرمة، وتتطلب التزامًا بالعمل ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة مجموعة المجال العربي. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. معلومات إضافية تُعد هذه الفرصة مناسبة للمحترفين الذين يسعون إلى المساهمة في تحسين وتطوير عمليات الخدمات العامة، والعمل في بيئة ديناميكية تدعم النمو المهني.

The role involves delivering care physically and through telemedicine to individuals and families across all age groups, focusing on preventive, acute, and chronic care. Key Responsibilities Conduct comprehensive telehealth and in-person consultations, including thorough patient history and physical examinations for family and general medicine complaints. Provide healthcare to the entire family medicine target population, across all ages and genders. Offer chronic disease and preventive care consultations and follow-ups in accordance with clinical guidelines. Utilize video conferencing platforms for symptom assessment, medical history review, and virtual examinations. Develop and implement personalized treatment plans, including medication management, specialist referrals, and lifestyle modifications. Oversee ongoing care for chronic and acute conditions, adjusting treatment plans based on patient feedback and clinical outcomes. Collaborate with other healthcare professionals to ensure seamless patient care. Practice population health management by identifying and addressing community health issues, implementing preventive measures, and promoting health education. Ability to promote health education and preventive measures. Proficiency in coordinating care with specialists and other healthcare professionals. Commitment to patient-centered care and optimizing health outcomes.

Key Responsibilities Ensure all duties are performed in a safe, efficient, and effective manner, complying with NOMAC safety rules and regulations. Report required spare parts and consumables to the Electrical Supervisor/Engineer and update on spares availability. Coordinate with the Electrical Supervisor and local operator to ensure proper isolations are carried out before commencing maintenance activities. Troubleshoot, diagnose problems, and perform maintenance on equipment within jurisdiction. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a relevant electrical technician role. 7de4caff76e1b796.description: About the Role Nissan Motor Corporation is seeking a Section Manager Digital Transformation to join its team in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role, based in Jeddah or Makkah, involves leading digital transformation, business intelligence, data analytics, systems integration, automation, data governance, and artificial intelligence initiatives within NKSA. The primary focus is on transforming Sales Performance, Dealer Network Development (DND), and Non-Technical Training through integrated data, digital tools, governed BI, and automation. The role requires 5-10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Own and maintain the prioritized NKSA transformation roadmap and backlog, with a primary focus on Sales Performance, DND, and Non-Technical Training. Map current processes, identify manual/repetitive activity, and redesign priority workflows using approved digital solutions. Develop or coordinate internal solutions including dealer assessment, DND expansion tracking, training/certification tools, and reporting automation. Assess vendor technical proposals, architecture, scalability, integration approach, security, implementation effort, and total cost of ownership. Measure before/after benefit realization, including hours saved, cycle-time reduction, errors reduced, cost avoidance, and user adoption. Business Intelligence and Data Management Own the evolution of the NKSA Sales Performance Dashboard into an integrated performance-management environment. Establish Power BI architecture, dashboard/UI standards, reusable data models, governed workspaces, and deployment processes in coordination with IT. Define common KPI architecture covering source, owner, logic, target, frequency, and management use to prevent duplicate or conflicting reporting. Build executive, functional, dealer, and operational views with drill-down capabilities across various organizational levels. Expand analytics progressively to DND, Training, CX, CCS, Production, and other approved functions. Systems Integration and Architecture Map current-state systems, interfaces, data flows, ownership, and dependencies across various platforms. Identify manual interfaces, duplicate data handling, quality gaps, and system limitations; define future-state integration priorities. Document API/interface requirements, data mappings, business rules, transformation logic, refresh frequency, authentication, monitoring, exception handling, and source-of-truth ownership. Coordinate technical feasibility with Local IT, Regional IS/IT, and enterprise system owners; support data pipelines, middleware, and warehouse/lakehouse requirements where approved. Maintain the Current-State System Map, Future-State Architecture, Data Flow Map, Integration Catalogue, Interface/API Register, and Application Dependency Map. Escalate blocked dependencies through agreed governance with clear owner, due date, and business impact. Prioritize approved use cases across forecasting assistance, lead scoring/prioritization, conversion and lost-sales analysis, dealer insights, and document intelligence. Drive approved Microsoft Copilot and AI-enabled productivity use cases with appropriate security, privacy, human oversight, and adoption controls. Prototype and technically evaluate AI/automation opportunities, then coordinate scale-up with Local/Regional IS/IT and relevant owners. Define value case, success measure, and control requirements for every use case before production scaling. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in digital transformation, business intelligence, data analytics, or related fields. Demonstrated ability to lead initiatives in data governance, systems integration, and automation. Experience acting as a business-side technical lead and product owner. Proficiency in translating operational needs into functional and technical requirements. Strong understanding of data governance, quality, security, and single source of truth principles.

7d3ed438510dffa1.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سول العربية التجارية عن مدير إدارة مشاريع للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور الإشراف العام على أنشطة إدارة المشاريع والبرامج، ويضمن تحقيق الأهداف المحددة ضمن الجداول الزمنية والميزانيات المخصصة. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 2-5 سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على تطوير وتنفيذ خطط المشاريع والبرامج، ومتابعة تقدير الموازنات المالية وتحديد المتطلبات البشرية والتقنية والمعدات اللازمة، وضمان توفيرها في الوقت المناسب وضمن التكلفة المقدرة. تحديد افتراضات المشروع والتداخلات البينية مع مشاريع أو برامج أخرى لضمان الاستغلال الأمثل للموارد، وتحديد مخاطر المشروع ووضع الخطوات اللازمة لتفاديها وحلها. التنسيق مع فريق العمل لمراجعة الأعمال المنجزة والمراحل المتبقية، والتأكد من الالتزام بنطاق المشروع ومعايير إدارة المشروع المعتمدة ومواصفات الجودة، وإدارة عمليات التغيير وفقًا للخطط الموضوعة. تنسيق ومتابعة عمليات إنهاء المراحل الرئيسية للمشروع وإغلاقه، وتقييم مدى تحقيق مخرجات المشروع لأهدافه، وضمان نقل المعارف والخبرات وتوثيق الوثائق والتقارير الخاصة بالمشروع. الإشراف على إعداد تقارير سير المشروع، وتقارير إدارة التحديات والمخاطر، وتقارير قياس مؤشرات الأداء وعوامل النجاح بشكل دوري، ورفعها للأطراف المعنية والإدارة العليا. نطاق الدور يتضمن الدور متابعة عمليات تطوير خطط تنفيذ المشاريع والبرامج، ومراقبة سير العمل فيها، ووضع وتتبع موازناتها وإجراءاتها التعاقدية. كما يشمل تحديد تكاليف المشاريع ومصادر تمويلها، ومتابعة عمليات التنفيذ لضمان إنجازها وتحقيق أهدافها بناءً على الجداول الزمنية والميزانيات المحددة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال إدارة المشاريع. فهم عميق لمنهجيات إدارة المشاريع وأفضل الممارسات. القدرة على الإشراف على فرق العمل وتوجيهها بفعالية. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة سول العربية التجارية. يتيح هذا الدور فرصة للمساهمة في إدارة مشاريع وبرامج حيوية للشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

7dbbbcd86c2aaf40.description: About the Role Al Nowras Speciality Clinics is seeking a qualified Dermatologist to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah. This full-time position involves providing comprehensive medical and cosmetic dermatology care to patients. Key Responsibilities Provide comprehensive medical dermatology care, including diagnosis and treatment planning. Manage acne cases, ensuring appropriate treatment and long-term follow-up. Deliver cosmetic dermatology services, including non-invasive cosmetic procedures. Perform evidence-based aesthetic treatments. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 years of experience in dermatology. Clinical expertise in Dermatology and Acne management. Proficiency in Cosmetic Dermatology and Cosmetology. Possession of a valid professional license or eligibility to obtain licensure to practice dermatology in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA). Required Skills Strong diagnostic and treatment planning abilities for dermatological conditions. Competence in performing non-invasive cosmetic procedures. Ability to apply evidence-based practices in aesthetic treatments. Work Environment This role is based in a clinic setting in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, and operates on a full-time schedule. The Dermatologist will work within a dedicated team focused on patient care. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

7d150d5f4d2ed110.description: About the Role Haskoning is seeking a Junior Project Manager to join its world-leading data centre design and engineering team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves supporting the delivery of complex, mission-critical projects across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the wider region. The position is suited for a project management professional interested in developing within large-scale data centre projects and working with international teams as Haskoning expands its Mission Critical Facilities (MCF) presence in KSA. Role Responsibilities As a Junior Project Manager within the Mission Critical Facilities Data Centres team, you will support senior project managers in the delivery of multidisciplinary data centre projects. Your responsibilities will span various project phases, from early feasibility and concept design to detailed design, procurement, construction activities, and final project delivery. Key responsibilities include: Supporting senior project managers in the delivery of complex data centre and mission-critical projects. Assisting with the coordination of multidisciplinary design and engineering teams. Supporting project controls, including planning, cost tracking, risk management, reporting, and change control. Helping manage project scope, deliverables, documentation, and stakeholder messaging. Contributing to client meetings, internal project reviews, and progress reporting. Supporting proposals, tenders, fee estimates, and project execution plans. Taking ownership of assigned tasks and smaller work packages while developing professional project management skills. Work Environment and Team Haskoning is an independent, employee-owned international consultancy specializing in engineering, design, and technology. The company operates with 6,800 colleagues across more than 25 countries, drawing on over 140 years of expertise. This role is part of the global Mission Critical Facilities (MCF) team, which provides multidisciplinary consultancy services to data centre clients, including colocation data centres, internet service providers, and telecom companies. The team comprises specialists in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, construction, civil, structure, building, architecture, fire safety, control engineering, and security technology. You will work from the Riyadh office, supporting colleagues and clients in KSA, and connecting with international teams and customers across the data centre network. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate is an initiative-taking, organized, and driven professional with a strong interest in complex technical projects. You should enjoy international teamwork and possess clear communication skills for interacting with clients, colleagues, and external stakeholders. A desire to develop into a project manager within the data centre sector is essential. Benefits and Development Haskoning offers a comprehensive benefits package focused on professional development and personal well-being. This includes a competitive base salary aligned with skills and experience, with annual increases. The company prioritizes employee well-being through flexibility, support, and a strong sense of community. Development opportunities include a range of training programs, tailored learning paths, learning weeks, and knowledge-sharing groups. The culture is informal and inclusive, promoting diversity and teamwork. The role offers opportunities for international collaboration with experienced colleagues across the global Mission Critical Facilities network, a long-term position with strong development prospects, and a workplace in the Riyadh office, KSA. A laptop and company cell phone are also provided.

7d2013561d4ba2a1.description: About the Role Concentrix is seeking a Trainer to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role is responsible for delivering client-focused training to address new hire, product update, and recursive training requirements, ensuring superior workforce preparation and service delivery. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Provide day-to-day functional direction to agents within the program training classroom environment. Monitor student progress, provide coaching and developmental feedback, and make readiness recommendations. Utilize effective presentation and facilitation skills, including creative training techniques and adult/accelerated learning methods. Prepare and present training materials through classroom learning, hands-on demonstrations, and supporting activities. Achieve individual training performance metrics. Support and partner with Operations to transition agents from training to production, ensuring competency levels meet business needs. Maintain relevant product knowledge for each account by taking calls, attending client and cross-functional meetings, and conducting side-by-side observations. Ensure effective and consistent communication with managers, peers, and other resource groups, including informal daily interaction with clients. Support the Instructional Design team in designing and developing training materials for various instructional delivery methods, including computer-based training, interactive, classroom training, and written job aids. Measure the effectiveness of training programs using various feedback methods such as focus groups, interviews, and surveys to enhance training resources and programs. Recommend curriculum modifications to the Training Manager/Supervisor based on internal customer feedback and/or Training Needs Analysis. Participate and contribute to a continuous learning culture by maintaining engagement on change management, product and service releases, policies, processes, and procedures. Required Qualifications and Experience Proven experience in training methodologies and soft skills (communication, critical thinking, time management, team building). Strong written and verbal communication skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office. Demonstrated ability to multi-task, prioritize, and meet timelines on deliverables. Self-starter with a sense of urgency, capable of working well under pressure. Strong attention to detail. Professionalism and the ability to develop good relationships. Ability to attain and maintain certification in the Trainer Certification Program (101/102). Career Framework This role requires knowledge and experience within its discipline, with an ongoing acquisition of higher-level knowledge and skills. The Trainer will analyze possible solutions using standard procedures and principles, build knowledge of the organization, processes, and customers, and solve a range of straightforward problems. The position receives a moderate level of guidance and direction.

7d97ff0dbea2aa73.description: About the Role The Luxury Collection is seeking a Director of Operations to lead hotel operations in Ad Diriyah, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position functions as the strategic business leader for the property's operations, encompassing Front Office, Recreation/Health Club, Housekeeping, Food and Beverage/Culinary, and Engineering/Maintenance. The Director will work with department heads to develop and implement strategies, ensuring alignment with brand service standards and initiatives. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement property-wide strategies to deliver products and services that meet or exceed customer and employee expectations, ensuring a return on investment. Demonstrate and communicate key drivers of guest satisfaction, analyze service issues, and identify trends to make informed decisions. Collaborate with the hotel management team to develop and execute an operational strategy aligned with the brand's business objectives. Monitor hotel operations sales performance against budget, review financial statements, and coach the operations team to manage occupancy, rate, wages, and controllable expenses effectively. Champion the brand’s service vision, ensuring alignment among hotel leadership teams and developing systems for employees to understand guest satisfaction results. Review guest feedback with the leadership team, ensure appropriate corrective actions are taken, and respond to guest problems and complaints. Maintain visibility and interface regularly with customers to obtain feedback on product quality, service levels, and overall satisfaction. Create an atmosphere in all Rooms and Food and Beverage areas that meets or exceeds guest expectations. Human Resources Management Facilitate the development of creative solutions to overcome obstacles and continuously improve guest satisfaction. Ensure fair and equitable treatment of employees and consistent, ongoing communication within Operations. Foster employee commitment to excellent service, participate in daily stand-up meetings, and model desired service behaviors. Incorporate guest satisfaction into staff/operations meetings, emphasizing innovative ways to improve results. Set goals and expectations for direct reports using the performance review process and hold staff accountable for performance. Solicit employee feedback, utilize an open-door policy, and review employee satisfaction results to address concerns. Ensure property policies are administered fairly and consistently, and disciplinary procedures are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs). Conduct annual performance appraisals with direct reports and champion change, ensuring brand and regional business initiatives are implemented. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in hotel operations leadership. Demonstrated ability to develop and implement departmental strategies. Proven track record in managing profitability, revenue goals, and guest experience. Experience in leading and developing operations and department teams. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Ad Diriyah, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring a leader who can drive operational excellence and foster positive owner relations within a luxury hospitality setting.

7decc8419389b684.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مغسلة الارض الخضراء لغسيل الملابس عن موظف استقبال بدوام كامل للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى موظف الاستقبال إدارة عمليات مكتب الاستقبال اليومية، ويعد نقطة الاتصال الأولى للعملاء، مما يضمن سير العمل بسلاسة وتقديم خدمة ممتازة. هذا الدور مناسب للمرشحين الذين يمتلكون خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية الترحيب بالعملاء ومساعدتهم فور وصولهم. التعامل مع المكالمات الواردة وتوجيهها بمهنية. إدارة الجدولة والمواعيد بكفاءة. حفظ السجلات وتنظيم المستندات الإدارية. ضمان تقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة وحل استفساراتهم أو شكاواهم. أداء المهام الكتابية العامة لدعم عمليات المنظمة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مهام الاستقبال أو خدمة العملاء. إتقان المهارات الكتابية، بما في ذلك الجدولة وحفظ السجلات وتنظيم المستندات. الإلمام بالتطبيقات الحاسوبية الأساسية وأدوات المكتب. المهارات المطلوبة آداب هاتف قوية ومهارات اتصال احترافية. مهارات خدمة عملاء فعالة لتلبية احتياجات العملاء وحل الاستفسارات. القدرة على إدارة الوقت بفعالية في بيئة عمل سريعة الوتيرة. بيئة العمل يعمل موظف الاستقبال في متجر الغسيل بالرياض، ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب التفاعل المستمر مع العملاء والزملاء. الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب الالتزام بتقديم أفضل مستويات الخدمة. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة تفاصيل الدور.

7d24fd868bd832d1.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة وجد الحياة للتجارة عن مهندس ضبط وتحكم في الجودة للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة وتطوير معايير وعمليات الجودة للمشاريع الهندسية، بالإضافة إلى مراقبة وتحليل عملية التنفيذ لضمان أعلى مستويات الجودة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تصميم معايير الجودة المخصصة للمشروعات الهندسية والإشراف على تطبيقها الفعال. إعداد تقارير دورية حول أداء المشاريع وتحديد المراحل الهامة القادمة. مقارنة التقدم الفعلي لسير العمل مع التقدم المخطط له، وتحليل أي ثغرات وتوضيح المخاطر المحتملة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب التقدم، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ضبط وتحكم الجودة أو مجال هندسي ذي صلة. القدرة على فهم وتطبيق معايير الجودة في المشاريع الهندسية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية لتحديد الثغرات والمخاطر. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق الفنية بوضوح ودقة. مهارات تواصل فعالة للتعاون مع فرق العمل المختلفة. الالتزام بالتطوير المستمر ومواكبة التقنيات الحديثة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مكة المكرمة. ستعمل ضمن فريق متخصص يركز على تحقيق أعلى معايير الجودة في كافة المشاريع الهندسية للشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية التوظيف.

7d8cb7434649ded8.description: About the Role Hill International, Inc. is seeking a Performance Monitoring & Reporting Engineer to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on developing and managing a comprehensive framework for performance monitoring and reporting across projects, ensuring accurate and consistent tracking of key performance indicators (KPIs) across all departments. Role Overview The Performance Monitoring & Reporting Engineer will be responsible for analyzing performance data to identify trends and areas for improvement, advising on KPIs, and providing regular reports to senior management. The position involves close collaboration with department heads to implement action plans and coordinate with the IT department to maintain reporting systems. This role also includes leading a performance monitoring team and ensuring compliance with established quality, environmental, safety, and occupational health policies. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement a comprehensive performance monitoring and reporting framework for projects. Oversee the collection, analysis, and reporting of key performance indicators (KPIs) across all departments. Ensure the accuracy, reliability, and consistency of performance data. Analyze performance data to identify trends, patterns, and areas for improvement. Advise on appropriate KPIs and performance metrics. Provide regular reports and updates to senior management on performance against targets and goals. Collaborate with department heads to develop action plans to address performance issues and enhance overall performance. Coordinate with the IT department to ensure optimal functioning of performance monitoring and reporting systems. Stay current with industry best practices in performance monitoring and reporting. Train and mentor staff in performance monitoring and reporting techniques and best practices. Lead and manage a team of performance monitoring and reporting professionals. Ensure continuous compliance with Hill International's Quality, Environmental, Safety, and Occupational Health Policies, Manuals, and Procedures. Perform other duties as assigned by the line manager/supervisor. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in performance monitoring and reporting. Demonstrated ability to develop and implement comprehensive performance frameworks. Strong analytical skills to interpret performance data and identify actionable insights. Experience in leading and managing a team of professionals. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role requires working within a dynamic project environment and collaborating across various departments.

7dd422511dc0a7a1.description: About the Role Hilton Riyadh Hotel & Residences is seeking a Purchasing Supervisor to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time position involves supporting procurement and inventory management processes to ensure efficient operations within the hotel. Role Overview The Purchasing Supervisor plays a key role in maintaining appropriate stock levels and ensuring timely delivery of goods. This position requires collaboration with various internal teams and external suppliers to meet operational needs and uphold quality standards. Key Responsibilities Support purchasing and receiving operations, including procurement, overseeing receiving processes, and managing inventory. Collaborate with outlet managers to ensure purchases align with operational needs and specifications. Process invoices, review for accuracy, and follow up on discrepancies to ensure timely payment and issue resolution. Assist with supplier management, including securing competitive pricing, placing orders, and tracking deliveries. Perform quality checks on shipments to verify adherence to order specifications, grade, and quality standards. Supervise and develop purchasing and receiving clerks through training, scheduling, and providing guidance. Required Qualities Candidates for this role should demonstrate qualities aligned with Hilton's core values, which include: A passion for hospitality. Acting with integrity. Leadership capabilities. A belief in teamwork for optimal outcomes. A strong sense of ownership and accountability. A focus on urgency and discipline in daily tasks. Work Environment This is a full-time position based at the Hilton Riyadh Hotel & Residences in Riyadh. The role involves working within a hotel environment, supporting daily operations related to purchasing and inventory. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply to join the Hotels team at Hilton Riyadh Hotel & Residences.

7daab0a2e2d3ea82.description: About the Role Fakeeh Care Group is seeking a Supply Chain Group Director to provide strategic leadership and direction for all supply chain functions across its entities. This full-time role is based in Makkah, with operations spanning Jeddah and Makkah, and requires over 10 years of experience. The Director will ensure group-wide alignment of supply chain strategies, promote standardization and best practices, and drive operational excellence, cost efficiency, and regulatory compliance. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this position is to oversee and integrate all supply chain functions, including procurement, planning, warehousing, logistics, and inventory management, across Fakeeh Care Group. The Group Director fosters collaboration between entity teams and ensures the effective delivery of high-quality, reliable, and sustainable supply chain services to support the Group’s clinical and operational goals. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement group-wide supply chain strategies aligned with Fakeeh Care’s mission, vision, and corporate objectives. Ensure integration and alignment of procurement, warehousing, logistics, and planning functions across all entities. Drive strategic sourcing initiatives, supplier consolidation, and long-term value creation. Establish group-wide policies, standards, and performance frameworks to ensure consistency and efficiency. Oversee supply chain operations across all entities to ensure compliance with regulatory, accreditation, and corporate requirements (MOH, SFDA, CBAHI, JCIA). Monitor performance metrics and compliance audits across procurement, inventory, and logistics activities. Ensure proper governance structures for contract management, vendor selection, and ethical procurement practices. Coordinate with entity leadership to resolve complex operational or compliance-related issues. Develop and monitor group-level KPIs to track performance, cost efficiency, and service quality. Promote data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement across all supply chain functions. Optimize cost of goods sold (COGS), inventory turnover, and procurement lead time through best practices and digital transformation. Lead initiatives to enhance system integration, automation, and reporting capabilities across entities. Provide leadership and guidance to entity supply chain directors and managers. Build strong cross-entity collaboration and knowledge-sharing frameworks. Promote succession planning, professional development, and skills enhancement for supply chain staff. Foster a culture of integrity, accountability, and service excellence across all supply chain teams. Collaborate with corporate and entity leaders (Finance, HR, Quality, Operations) to align supply chain priorities with Fakeeh Care Group goals. Prepare and present performance reports, risk assessments, and strategic updates to senior leadership. Represent the Supply Chain Group in executive meetings, committees, and corporate initiatives. Perform other related duties as assigned within the scope of the job. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in supply chain management. Demonstrated strategic leadership capabilities in a complex organizational setting. Proven ability to drive operational excellence, cost efficiency, and regulatory compliance. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Makkah, with responsibilities extending to operations in Jeddah and Makkah. The role involves working within a dynamic healthcare group, collaborating with various corporate and entity leaders to achieve strategic objectives. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to apply for this position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

7dd4453214d184d7.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مهد النماء للتجارة والمقاولات عن مشرف إنشاء طرق للانضمام إلى فريقها في عنيزة، القصيم. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، حيث سيقوم المشرف بإعداد خطط العمل ومتابعة تنفيذ مشاريع إنشاء الطرق لضمان الالتزام بالمواصفات والمعايير الفنية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة المخططات الهندسية للطرق ووثائق المناقصة، وإعداد خطة وبرنامج العمل بالتنسيق مع مهندس الطرق المشرف. تقدير كميات المواد وحجم العمالة اللازمة لتنفيذ مشاريع الطرق. متابعة إجراءات ونشاطات تنفيذ الطرق لضمان التقيد بالمواصفات المحددة. أخذ عينات عشوائية من مواد إنشاء الطرق وإرسالها إلى المختبر للفحص ومطابقة المواصفات، وذلك بحسب تعليمات مهندس الطرق المشرف. أخذ عينات عشوائية من الخلطات الإسفلتية وإرسالها إلى المختبر لمطابقة المواصفات. قياس الأعمال المنجزة بالتنسيق مع مهندس الطرق المشرف. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال إنشاء الطرق أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات الهندسية ووثائق المناقصات. معرفة جيدة بمواصفات ومعايير إنشاء الطرق. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية وتخطيطية ممتازة. القدرة على المتابعة الدقيقة لخطوات التنفيذ. مهارات التواصل الفعال والعمل ضمن فريق. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة عنيزة بمنطقة القصيم، وتتطلب العمل الميداني في مواقع مشاريع إنشاء الطرق. التقديم لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذه الوظيفة. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة للتقديم.

7d4696d6e6cb513a.description: About Cundall and the Role Cundall is seeking a Senior Structural Engineer to join its team in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position within Cundall’s Structural Engineering team, which focuses on designing sustainable structural solutions. The team is recognized for its expertise and collaborative approach to professional development.
